title: Shaadi Dictionary

caption_options.label: short
caption_options.text: Some words change after marriage. Bas 5 minute, acha suno, kha liya, theek hai - sabka meaning ghar ke andar alag ho jaata hai.

caption_options.label: hinglish
caption_options.text: Shaadi dictionary, but in our format: same words, more meaning.

alt_text: Illustrated Hinglish carousel about Indian married shorthand: bas 5 minute means both partners are lying, acha suno means one more household task, mil gaya means the third shelf, kha liya means missing you, theek hai means the plate is covered, and home means same words with more meaning.
